notes.note:
The tab bar can now be shown at either the top or bottom of the screen on [Firefox for Android][1]. Check `Settings` -> `Customize` to configure.


  [1]: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.mozilla.firefox_beta

Firefox's Translations feature now supports the following languages:

 - Albanian 
 - Belarusian
 - Filipino
